content:
One capability CETI uses every week, one move, ~25 s, the little whale flying over a hydrographic chart. Shared layer: chart ground (air mode is never bare), opening card, paper caption chips, closing lockup; one tool and one build command per episode; a reusable builder brief.

## Provenance

- **Colour provenance:** PASS — 36 literal colours, 36 registered tokens, 0 declared derived

## What changed
New series. Adds the chart ground to air mode, the lockup-takes-the-caption rule and the phone-legibility scale rule (learned in review round 1).
